CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Origin and Consequences of Sin? (1 mark)
   A. Use Origin and Consequences of Sin to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Origin and Consequences of Sin has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Origin and Consequences of Sin.
   D. Apply the teaching of Origin and Consequences of Sin with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Holy Spirit has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Holy Spirit to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of God’s Plan for Redemption? (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God’s Plan for Redemption.

   A. Say Healing of the Paralytic has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Healing of the Paralytic to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings on Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings on Prayer.
   B. Apply the teaching of Teachings on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Teachings on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Teachings on Prayer has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Calming the Storm? (1 mark)
   A. Use Calming the Storm to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Calming the Storm.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Lost Sheep? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Lost Sheep to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Lost Sheep has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Lost Sheep with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Lost Sheep.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Faith and God’s Promises? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith and God’s Promises.
   B. Say Faith and God’s Promises has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Faith and God’s Promises to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Faith and God’s Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel: Saul? (1 mark)

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

13. Which response best shows understanding of Abrahamic Covenant? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Abrahamic Covenant.

   D. Say Abrahamic Covenant has no place in daily life.

14. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

15. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi? (1 mark)
